mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, total_minutes, valid_days, price, description, featured, status, created_at FROM plans ORDER BY price ASC
SELECT id, code, name, total_minutes, valid_days, price, description, featured, status, created_at FROM plans WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY price ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (id, code, name, total_minutes, valid_days, price, description, featured, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{totalMinutes}, #{validDays}, #{price}, #{description}, #{featured}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE plans SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, total_minutes = #{totalMinutes}, valid_days = #{validDays}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, featured = #{featured}, status = #{status}, created_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id}
